title: Chickpea Curry in Spiced Tomato-Onion Gravy
summary: A hearty vegan Indian-style chickpea curry simmered in a warmly spiced tomato and onion gravy. It is comforting, pantry-friendly and ideal for a weeknight dinner with rice or flatbread.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until soft, golden at the edges and sweet-smelling.
Add the garlic, ginger and green chilli. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring, until fragrant and no longer raw-smelling.
Stir in the cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, paprika and cayenne. Cook for 30 seconds so the spices bloom in the oil, taking care they do not burn.
Add the canned tomatoes, tomato paste, salt and black pepper. Simmer for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomato mixture thickens and the oil starts to glisten around the edges.

Stir in the chickpeas and coconut milk. Bring to a gentle simmer, then cook uncovered for 12–15 minutes until the gravy is creamy and the chickpeas are hot and tender. Add a splash of water if it becomes thicker than you like.
Stir in the lemon juice and half the fresh coriander. Taste and adjust the salt or cayenne if needed.
Serve hot, scattered with the remaining coriander, with rice or another vegan side.
